## Sign convention (must match the L10 reading)

This demo uses:

$$\Delta\\lambda = \\lambda_{\\text{obs}} - \\lambda_0$$

- $v_r > 0$ means **receding** → wavelengths increase → redshift
- $v_r < 0$ means **approaching** → wavelengths decrease → blueshift

Implementation reference: `demos/_assets/doppler-shift-model.js`

## Data integrity

This demo uses the shared spectra contract:

- Contract: `docs/contracts/spectra-data-contract.md`
- Seed atomic lines: `demos/_assets/spectra/atomic-lines.v1.json`

## Physics model

ASTR 101 mode (non-relativistic; $v \\ll c$):

$$\\lambda_{\\text{obs}} = \\lambda_0(1 + v_r/c)$$
